title: Fantastic scheduling app!
body:
This app has been so useful for me! I have raging ADHD but I work better with a schedule, so I would always write one on a piece of paper, and forget about it after a couple of days. Plus, if anything changed from the schedule it would all get thrown out for the day, because it was too difficult to fit new things around it. This app solves all the problems I have with this! 

I can set up my whole week’s schedule, to be recurring week in week out, and the app will always pop up to remind me to move to the next task, go eat dinner, start winding down to bed, etc. I spent so long looking for an app like this, and I’m so glad I’ve found one! Thank you to the developers for making it accessible for people on shoestring budgets too, it’s really appreciated.

title: LOVE IT!  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
body:
I’ve never left a review for any other app but this one…. I had to because it’s that AMAZING! Some of the things I love about the app is:

-  ‘Inbox’ I love that I can brain dump everything here and schedule a time and date when it has one but it keeps it of my head so I’m not stressing about it. 
- ‘Subtask’ I love that I can have a main heading and have all these little tasks listed under it which makes it look/ feel less overwhelming because you can’t actually see them on the calendar view. 
- It’s super cute!!! The colours, icons…. EVERYTHING! 
- Being able to see gaps in between tasks so you can maximise your time. Also the little motivational sayings to fill your time. 

I’ve downloaded so many productivity/ organisation apps but I would always fall out of using them because they never had all the features needed to keep using it BUT this one does!!!! Super impressed

body:
